messages:
Devon: Heads-up — planning a deploy of service-api v2.0 to prod today. Target window 16:30 PT. @Mia can you own smoke and rollback if needed?
Mia: Yep I can be on deck for smoke & rollback. I'll stand by from 16:15–17:15 PT.
Jamal: I’ll watch DB migrations and run a quick dry-run on staging now. No schema changes included in this release.
Lina: FYI I updated the runbook with the new escape-hatch commands and the canary gating checks: https://runbooks.redwood/local/service-api-deploy (see section "Rollback & Escape Hatch")
Devon: Thanks. Quick checklist before we hit go: 1) Canary at 10% for 10m, 2) smoke tests green, 3) latency SLOs hold, 4) rollback path validated. Agree?
Ava: +1 on the checklist. Also make sure the analytics job consumer is paused for the first 5m — avoids noisy alarms. I can pause it at deploy time.
Mia: Outline of smoke checks I’ll run: health endpoint, sample end-to-end flow, auth login flow, tracing spans present, and a batch of 1000 embedding calls to ensure model fallback still ok.
Jamal: Migration watcher ready. I’ll alert if any locks >30s or if replicas restart.
Devon: Rollback command snippets (also in runbook):
```
# quick rollback to previous image
kubectl set image deploy/service-api service-api=redwood/service-api:20260302-abcdef
# safer: rollback rollout
kubectl rollout undo deploy/service-api
```
Mia: Escape hatch owner: @Mia. If error rate >0.5% sustained for 3m or 95th latency > 1200ms for 5m, escalate and rollback.
Lina: I'll be monitoring dashboards and will post screenshots if anything looks off. Also added a temporary alert threshold for this rollout.
Devon: Okay team, final call — deploying canary in 5. Reply with :thumbsup: to indicate GO.
Mia: :thumbsup: GO (oncall: Mia)
Jamal: :thumbsup: GO
Lina: :thumbsup: GO — monitoring ready
OpsBot: Deploy ticket #4521 created and scheduled. Canary rollout started at 16:30 PT.
Devon: Canary up at 10%. Initial metrics: error rate 0.02%, 95th latency 340ms. Proceeding to 50% after 8m if stable.
Mia: Smoke pass (health, auth, e2e). No regressions on sampled traces.
Ava: Analytics consumer paused.
Devon: Increasing to 50% now.
Lina: Seeing a small spike in 500s on one pod — digging in, might be transient.
Mia: I'm seeing error rate jump to 0.65% on canary for ~2m, rolling back now.
Jamal: Initiating rollback per runbook.
Devon: Executing rollback command.
OpsBot: Rollback initiated by Devon.
Devon: Rollback complete. Verification: pods back to previous image, error rate back down to baseline.
Mia: Post-rollback checklist: collect logs from canary pods, capture flame graphs, and create a quick regression issue. I'll open the PR with failing traces attached.
Lina: Noted. I saved the dashboard snapshots.
Jamal: DB migrations stayed idle — no impact.
Devon: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: 1) root-cause triage tomorrow 09:30 PT, 2) keep runbook notes updated with what happened. Closing this rollout.
Ava: Re-enabled analytics consumer.
OpsBot: Deploy ticket #4521 closed (rolled back).
